drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 76-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.49, bnp 1105, creatinine 1.91, hemoglobin 12.4, platelets 209, sodium 140, wbc 7.5; vitals dbp 65-68, heart_rate 73-78, map 87-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 130-132, spo2 96-98, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 31%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.91, hemoglobin 12.3, platelets 218, sodium 139, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 64-70, heart_rate 73-78, map 87-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 127-134, spo2 96-98, temp 36.8-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 76-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
